scored_by: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via scripts/rubric.mjs, two independent passes per asset (pass A on the 8x plain view, pass B on the debug sheet), before any art change

verdict.note: Independent baseline for the Surface Fidelity track, recorded before any art change. All fourteen passes are vision-model passes on gemini-3.5-flash-lite, so basis is independent and no caveat applies. Two passes scored lighting 2 — humanoid pass A and scene pass A, both on the plain 8x view and 3 on the debug sheet — so the floor is tripped by view-to-view disagreement on unchanged art. They stay in the record; Phase 6 must fix the art rather than this note.

silhouette.why: The distinct shape of a corked bottle with a bulbous base is immediately clear at 1x without any color cues.

value_separation.why: The cork, glass outline, liquid, and inner label/shadows are mostly distinct, though the lightest glass tone and background white create a slight edge merge.

lighting.why: The highlights suggest a consistent light source from the top-left, but some inner shading feels flat rather than fully rounded.

edge_language.why: The solid dark outline defines the silhouette effectively, but inner details lack a clear distinction between material edges and surface shading.

cluster_discipline.why: Forms are built with solid pixel groups and clean stair-stepping, avoiding random confetti pixels.

palette_craft.why: The colors fit a classic potion aesthetic with readable ramps, though the hue shifts and value steps could be more harmonious.
